tilt-card: `max` sets the maximum tilt angle and `glare` controls the highlight that follows the pointer. The default slot holds the card content.
button-magnetic: `strength` sets the magnetic pull, 0.25 by default; the button accepts ButtonBase props and native events.
button-metallic: `paused` stops the silver sheen and `size` sets the size.
hold-action-button: `holdDuration` sets the confirmation time in milliseconds, `direction` picks the fill direction, and `@hold-complete` fires when the hold finishes. Pointer, Space and Enter are supported.
action-swap-roll: `animation="roll"` swaps the content with a rolling motion, `items` defines the action list, and `v-model` syncs the current id.
action-swap-blur: `animation="blur"` cross-fades the content with blur, and `items`, `v-model` and `#icon` configure the content and state.
action-swap-cascade: `animation="cascade"` swaps characters one by one. `items` provides the labels and ids, and `@value-change` delivers the new id and the full item.
voice-orb: Pass an `activity` value from 0 to 1, a MotionValue or an `analyser` to drive the upstream WebGL material. `colors`, `active` and `speed` control the look and animation, and `@error` reports render failures.
message-bubble: `align`, six `variant` values and `animateIn` control the bubble. Combine MessageBubbleContent, MessageBubbleGroup and MessageBubbleCollapsible, and use `v-model:open` to manage collapsing.
message: `from` sets user or assistant. Combine MessageAvatar, MessageContent, MessageHeader, MessageFooter, MessageMarker, MessageTyping and MessageGroup, or embed MessageBubble in the content.
message-scroller: `followOutput`, `followThreshold` and `smooth` control the follow output, and `@follow-change` reports the reading position. `busy` marks a live log, and `navigation=rail` provides per-message navigation.
prompt-input: `v-model` or `defaultValue` controls the text. `models` and `v-model:model` set the model, and `actions` with `@action` extends the tools. Enter submits and Shift+Enter inserts a newline. `@submit` returns the text and model, and `loading` with `@stop` interrupts generation.
todo-list: `items` takes tasks with id, title, status, progress and detail. `v-model:open` and `collapseOnComplete` control the progress list, and `#item` customizes the task content.
code-block: `code`, `language` and `filename` set the content, `highlightLines`, `wrap`, `maxHeight` and `showLineNumbers` manage the presentation, and `copyable` and `onCopy` manage copying.
approval-card: Use `questions`, `v-model:step` and `v-model:answers` to configure single choice, multiple choice and custom answers. `@submit` returns the answers. Review mode provides `@approve`, `@reject` and `@request-changes`, and `status` with `#result` displays the outcome.
file-diff: `file` and `lines` define the file and its added and removed lines, and `status` distinguishes streaming from complete. `v-model:open`, `collapseOnComplete` and `maxHeight` manage the diff area, and `copyText` customizes the copied text.
tool-result: `tool`, `title`, `kind` and `status` mark a terminal, request or custom result. Show the output with the default slot or ToolResultOutput, handle failures with `@retry`, and provide copy text with `copyText`.
streaming-response: The default slot receives the streaming content, and `status`, `announce` and `showActions` control announcements and completion actions. `copyText`, `@retry`, `sources`, `v-model:feedback` and `v-model:sources-open` can be configured.
image-generation: `status` accepts queued, generating, refining, complete and error. Pass the slot media, `prompt`, `resolution` and `aspectRatio`; `interactive` enables pointer response, and `@retry` handles failures.
tool-approval: `tool`, `title` and `parameters` describe the action, and `v-model:open` reveals the parameters. Handle the choice with `@approve`, `@always-allow` and `@deny`; `status` is managed by the caller.
citations: `citations` holds id, title, domain and url. Manage the source list with `v-model:open`; Citation entries that share an `idPrefix` can be opened from the body text, which focuses the source.
agent-activity: Pass `items` combining step, text, search, tool and trace events; `status`, `duration` and `collapseOnComplete` manage the running and completion behavior. `#item`, `#working-status` and `#completed-status` replace the default content.
reasoning-text: `phrases` and `interval` set the rotating copy, `variant` supports cascade, swap and scramble, and `#indicator` replaces the leading icon.
agent-progress: `label` marks the activity, `initialSeconds` initializes the internal timer, `running` pauses or resumes it, and `elapsedSeconds` switches to external control.
ai-sidebar: `defaultItems` or `v-model:items` provides the tree, and `v-model:active-id` syncs the selection. Arrow keys, F2 to rename, drag and drop, and Alt+Shift+arrow keys to move are supported. `onMove` and `onRename` may return a Promise; on failure the original data is restored.
chat-app: `#sidebar` and the default slot form the chat shell. The slot provides `open` and `setOpen`, and the main content also receives `toggle`. `sidebarWidth` and `collapseSidebarBelow` control the docked width, and `v-model:open` is managed by the caller.
infinite-masonry: Use `items` and `getItemKey` to provide the content; the default scoped slot receives `item` and `index`. `hasMore`, `onLoadMore`, `loading` and `error` manage batched loading, and `estimateSize` informs column height allocation.
notification-stack: `items` defines the notifications. `v-model:expanded` manages the collapsed state, `maxVisible` caps the stack depth, and `onViewAll` handles viewing all.
project-folder: `title`, `description`, `previews` and `count` describe the project. `v-model:open` and `v-model:expanded` control opening the folder and expanding the details.
card-folder: `title`, `cardNumber`, `expiry` and `cvv` describe the displayed card. `v-model:open` and `v-model:detailsVisible` control opening the card and showing its details separately.
knockout-wheel: `rounds` provides the matchups from the first round to the final, and `initialRound` selects the outermost ring. Focus, hover or click a node to view that match's score.
knockout-bracket: `rounds` defines the knockout rounds. `initialRound` sets the starting column, `thirdPlace` adds a third-place match, and matches support `winner` and `penalties`.
availability-scheduler: Use `v-model` to receive the weekly schedule, `defaultValue` to initialize the working days and `step` to set the minute interval; overlapping or reversed time ranges are constrained.
swap: `chains` and `tokens` define the networks and local quotes, and `defaultFromId` and `defaultToId` set the currencies. `@swap` provides the amount, the exchange estimate and the destination address.
dynamic-island: When `view` is null the `#compact` content is shown; otherwise the `DynamicIslandView` whose id matches is shown. The container transitions to the content size.
command-palette: `items` defines the commands with keywords and groups, `v-model:open` controls the dialog, `shortcut` sets the keyboard shortcut, and `@select` returns the selected item.
morphing-search-chips: `v-model:chips`, `v-model:query` and `v-model:recents` manage the chips, the input and recent searches. `storageKey` enables local history, and `@search` returns the keyword and chips.
morphing-search: `items` provides the filterable entries, `iconOnly` toggles the trigger appearance, and `v-model:open` with `@select` manage command search.
expandable-action-bar: `items` describes the actions, icons and disabled state, `v-model:expanded` controls whether the toolbar is expanded, `activeId` marks the current action, and `@action` receives the item.
overflow-actions: `primaryActions` and `overflowActions` separate the common actions from the additional ones. `v-model:expanded` and `collapseOnAction` manage the expansion behavior.
expandable-tabs: `items` provides the labels, icons and content, `v-model` controls the active panel, and `#panel` customizes the content; arrow keys and Escape are supported.
morphing-tabs: `items` and `v-model` configure the tabs. Drag, or press Alt plus the arrow keys, to reorder; `@order-change` returns the new order, and `onClose` handles closing.
swipeable-list: `leftActions` and `rightActions` on each entry in `items` define the actions on both sides. Swipe and the keyboard buttons are supported, and `@action` returns the row, action and direction.
attachment-upload: `accept`, `maxFiles` and `maxFileSize` constrain the attachments. `v-model` syncs the queue, and drag and drop, removal, slots and independent progress are supported.
file-upload: `v-model` syncs the file queue, `multiple`, `accept`, `maxFileSize` and `maxFiles` control what is accepted, and `@value-change` returns the new queue.
prediction-market-card: `outcomes` provides the probabilities, `volumeHistory` draws a mini chart, and `v-model:bookmarked` stores the bookmark. `@outcome-click` returns the outcome and side.
prediction-market: `v-model` manages the mode, outcome and quantity. `balance`, `positions` and `minTrade` are used for quote validation, and `@trade` returns the order and estimate.
wallet-card: `accounts`, `v-model:accountId` and `balance` display the accounts. Balances can be hidden, recently used entries searched, and `@send`, `@deposit`, `@swap` and `@buy` listened to.
otp-input: `v-model` syncs the numeric code, `length` sets the length, and `mask` hides the digits. `@complete` fires when entry finishes, and `status` shows the validation result.
signup-form: `v-model:values` syncs the sign-up data, and `validate` can override validation. `onSubmit` supports async submission, and `strengthMeter` controls the password strength hint.
card-dealer: The `zone` of each entry in `cards` moves it between the deck, the hand and the discard pile. `#face` and `#back` customize the two sides, and `@card-select` returns the hand card's id.
bloom-menu: `items` defines the radial menu actions; the trigger expands them, and `@select` returns the current label. Keyboard and Escape are supported.
feedback-widget: `onSubmit` receives the feedback text and may return a Promise, `title`, `placeholder` and `labels` override the copy, and `position` controls the opening direction.
not-found-glitch: Renders `code` with glitched characters. `title`, `description`, `homeHref` and `browseHref` customize the copy and navigation.
not-found-magnetic: The error code shifts with the pointer position; `code`, `title`, `description` and two navigation links are configurable.
not-found-spotlight: The spotlight follows the pointer; `code`, the page description and custom navigation links are supported.
not-found-stacked: Displays `code` with a stacked visual. Set the recovery paths with `homeHref`, `browseHref` and their labels.
not-found-terminal: Presents `code` in a terminal style; `labels.terminalError` overrides the command prompt, and navigation uses `homeHref` and `browseHref`.
bar-chart: `series` and `categories` provide the data, `layout` and `orientation` switch grouping, stacking and direction, and `sort` orders by the visible total. `v-model:hidden-series` and `v-model:active-id` are supported.
donut-chart: `segments` defines the shares, and `gap` and `thickness` adjust the ring. `v-model:active-id`, `selectedId`, `@select` and the `#center` slot are supported.
sparkline: `data` provides the samples, `label` names the graphic, and `interactive` enables pointer and keyboard inspection. `curve`, `variant`, `showDelta` and `invertDelta` are supported.
status-bar: `data` provides the time observations, `statuses` customizes the status colors and names, `v-model:active-id` syncs the inspected position, and `#tooltip` customizes the reading.
composition-chart: Provide `series` and `periods`, and use `view` to switch between the percentage stacked bars and the area. `v-model:period` syncs the inspected period, and clicking a legend item pins the highlight.
candlestick-chart: `candles` provides OHLCV data with stable ids, `lastPrice` draws the reference price, and `v-model:active-id` syncs the candle under the crosshair.
heat-calendar: `values[week][day]` uses a 0–1 intensity, shown as a reading with `maxCount` and `unit`. `endDate` accepts a UTC date. `v-model:selection` syncs a single day and a date range.
order-book: `bids` and `asks` accept price and size snapshots, `levels` controls the depth, and `v-model:active-level` syncs the inspected price level. `@level-select` receives the price and side, and `#summary` customizes the cumulative depth.
returns-calendar: `years` and `returns[year][month]` provide yearly and monthly returns; yearly totals and cross-month or cross-year selections use compounding. `v-model:selection` syncs the selection.
funnel-chart: `stages` provides ordered stages, identifiers and values, and `direction` switches the direction. Interactive readings show the change from the previous step, the conversion rate and the total conversion rate.
bump-chart: `series[].ranks` corresponds to `periods`; a missing rank keeps a gap, and `v-model:active` syncs the pinned series.
liquidity-heatmap: `snapshots` provides the time, liquidity by level and market price track, and `maxSize` fixes the color scale. The pointer and arrow keys inspect individual cells.
price-target-fan: `current`, `targets` and `history` provide the current price, three targets and historical prices, `dates` customizes the axis labels, and `v-model:active` syncs the active target or historical reading.
sankey-chart: `nodes` and `links` define the weighted flows; `nodeWidth`, `nodePadding` and `colors` configure the layout and colors, and `v-model:active-id` syncs the active node or link.
treemap: `data` provides groups or leaf nodes; leaf area is computed from weight, `v-model:active-id` syncs interaction, and the arrow keys move between leaf nodes.
volume-profile: `data` provides non-overlapping price ranges and volume, and `valueArea` sets the value-area coverage ratio or false. `v-model:active-id` syncs the selected range.
arc-picker: Pass `options` and sync the option with `v-model`. `side` sets the arc direction, and `radius`, `visibleCount` and `itemHeight` adjust the curve. Keyboard, wheel and drag are supported.
date-range-picker: `v-model` holds `{ from, to? }` or `null`, with dates formatted as YYYY-MM-DD. `inline`, `v-model:open`, `presets`, `min`, `max`, `locale` and `isDateDisabled` are supported.
color-picker: `v-model` is an RGB or RGBA hex string. Use `presets` for preset colors and `v-model:open` to control the popover. Keyboard adjustment, alpha, HEX/RGB/HSL input and the browser color picker are supported.
color-selector: `options` provides `label`, `value` and `color`; bind the selected value with `v-model`, and `name` participates in native form submission.
pagination: `v-model` syncs the current page, `totalPages` sets the page count, and `siblings` and `boundaries` adjust the visible page numbers. The ellipsis jumps pages.
breadcrumb: `items` defines the path entries with `label` and `href`. `maxItems` controls the collapse threshold. Use `@navigate` to receive the entry, its index and the native click event.
avatar-group: `members` provides `id`, `name` and an optional image `src`. `max`, `size`, `v-model:expanded`, image fallback and hover expansion are supported.
input: `v-model` binds the text, and `label`, `error`, `success` and `reserveErrorLine` configure the field state. `#leftIcon` and `#rightIcon` customize the affixes.
select: Pass `options` and `v-model`. Keyboard navigation, first-letter lookup, disabled options, groups, `#option` and `#value` are supported.
select-morph: Configure the select with `options`, `v-model` and `label`. The popover is revealed from the trigger's edge, and the arrow keys plus Enter make the selection.
combobox: `options` provides the options plus optional `group`, `detail` and `keywords`. After typing to filter, use the arrow keys and Enter to select, and `v-model` syncs the selected value.
multi-select: `v-model` is an array of selected values, and `options` sets the searchable items. Removing a tag individually, removing with Backspace and groups are supported.
checkbox: `v-model` binds a boolean, and `indeterminate` marks a partial selection. `label`, `disabled`, `name`, `value` and `required` are supported.
radio: `options` defines the radio options, `v-model` binds the selection, and `label` describes the group's purpose. Native form behavior and arrow-key operation are preserved.
dropdown-menu: `items` supports nested actions, checkboxes, radio items, headings and separators. `@select` returns the triggering item, and `v-model:open` and keyboard navigation are supported.
popover: `#trigger` defines the button content, and the default slot defines the popover and receives `close`. `trigger=hover`, `side`, `align` and `v-model:open` are supported.
popover-morph: `#trigger` defines the trigger text, and the default slot receives `close`. `v-model:open` controls the popover, which is revealed from the trigger's edge.
tooltip: Set the trigger with the default slot and the hint with `content`. `side`, `align`, `arrow`, `followCursor` and `delay` are supported, and Escape closes it.
context-menu: The default slot is the context target and `items` defines the actions. Right-click, long press and Shift+F10 are supported, and `@select` returns the current item.
text-scramble: Pass `text`; when it updates, the characters decode from left to right. `duration` is in milliseconds, and `glyphs` customizes the scramble characters.
text-reveal: `text` accepts a single line or multiple lines, and `split` is set to `word` or `char`. `delay`, `stagger`, `blur`, `yOffset` and `spring` tune the entrance. `whileInView` and `once` control viewport triggering.
text-shimmer: The default slot holds the text. `duration` controls the seconds per sweep, `paused` pauses it, and `as` changes the semantic element.
text-cascade: Pass `text`; on update, two layers of text scroll character by character. Screen readers read the full text.
chromatic-text-reveal: Pass a fixed `prefix` and rotating `words`. Customize the sweep with `colors`, `foregroundColor`, `duration`, `delay` and `pauseDuration`. `loop`, `paused`, `startOnView` and `once` are supported.
marquee: The default slot holds the scrolling content. `direction` has four directions and `speed` is the seconds per cycle. `gap`, `fade`, `pauseOnHover` and `paused` control the spacing, the fade and pausing respectively.
scroll-reveal: Place the content in the default slot. Pass `root` to scope the scroll container. `amount` controls the visible ratio, `once` controls repeated entrances, and `y`, `blur`, `duration` and `delay` tune the animation.
scroll-progress: `variant` picks `bar` or `circle`. It tracks the page by default; use `container` to set the scroll element or `progress` to pass a 0 to 1 value or MotionValue. `spring`, `fixed`, `height`, `size` and `thickness` are supported.
parallax: The default slot shifts with scrolling. `speed` may be negative, `axis` picks `x` or `y`, `container` sets the scroll area, and `spring` controls the smoothing.
scroll-to: `to` accepts a selector, element or pixel position. `container` sets the scroll area, `offset` leaves room for a fixed bar, and `duration` is in seconds. The default slot is the button content.
thinking-shimmer: Customize the thinking hint with the default slot or `labels.thinking`; `duration` defaults to 1.8 seconds, and `paused` pauses it.
crash: `getCrashPoint` provides a sync or async result per round. Use `v-model:auto-cash-out` to configure auto cash-out, and `@start`, `@cash-out` and `@crash` report round state. The example uses local preset results.
crash-balloon: Start with `:crash-at="null"` to wait for the reveal. `@start` receives the round number, reveal a round with `{ round, value }`, and `@cash-out` fires once a valid result is confirmed. The example reveals locally after a delay.
crash-tower: The tower shares `getCrashPoint`, `crashAt`, auto cash-out and round events with `Crash`. `v-model:sound` controls the synthesized sound; the example rotates local results.
mines: Configure the board with `size` and `v-model:mines`; `@reveal` receives the cell, type and current multiplier, and `@cash-out` receives the multiplier and gem count. `random` can inject a deterministic random source, and `minesMultiplier` computes the fair odds.
plinko: `rows` generates the peg grid, and `slots` can override each landing value. `maxBalls` controls how many balls run at once, and `@land` receives the zero-based landing slot and the displayed value. `plinkoSlots` generates a symmetric sequence, and results are shown immediately with reduced motion.
slide-game: `v-model:bet` and `v-model:target` configure the simulated round. `getResult` returns a number or Promise each round, and `@result` receives the result, the locked target and the simulated stake once the round stops. `slideResult` accepts a reproducible random source and edge parameters.
bookshelf: `books` configures the covers, spines and authors. `v-model` is the expanded book id. Arrow keys move focus and Enter expands. `sound` and `tilt` control the tactile feedback.
timeline: `events` uses UTC dates, and `v-model` sets the current event. Dragging, inertial snapping, clicking and arrow keys are supported. Customize the card with the `media` and `meta` slots.
sortable-stack: `v-model` binds an array of items with `id` and `title`. Drag the handle to reorder, or press Space to lift, use the arrow keys to move and Space to drop. Undo is supported.
morphing-lightbox: `images` takes images with `src` and `alt`. `v-model` sets the current image id. Left and right keys, swipe navigation and Esc to close are supported.
expandable-control: `variant` is `button` or `chip`. Configure the content with the `label`, `actionLabel` and `icon` slots. Emits `activate` or `remove`.
adaptive-stepper: `v-model` is the numeric value. `min`, `max` and `step` constrain stepping, and the button at a reached boundary is collapsed. `name` supports form submission.
bottom-sheet: `v-model:open` controls the sheet. `snapPoints` sets the viewport height ratios. Drag the handle or press the up and down arrow keys to resize.
pull-to-refresh: Pass an async `onRefresh` function. Pull down at the top of the scroll area and release to refresh. `threshold` and `maxPull` control the trigger distance and resistance.
shared-layout-bg: The direct children of the default slot share the background. When the pointer moves or keyboard focus changes, the background springs to the target's position and size.
bounce-sidebar: `items` provides the labels and optional links, and `v-model` is the current item id. The active marker bounces along the list.
animated-sidebar: `items` supports submenus. `v-model` and `v-model:open` control the current item and the expanded state. Narrow screens use a modal drawer. Ctrl+B or Cmd+B toggles it.
file-tree: `items` uses recursive `children`. `v-model` binds the file and `v-model:expanded` binds the list of expanded directory ids. Arrow keys, Home and End are supported.
preview-rail: Point at, focus or tap a tick in `items` to show its preview. `orientation` and `previewSide` configure the layout. The `preview` slot customizes the content.
dock: `items` supports icons, links and a `separatorBefore` separator. `v-model` sets the active item, and the `icon` slot provides custom icons.
morphing-modal: It is closed when `v-model:view-id` is `null`. Changing the view id makes the panel animate to the content height. The default slot provides `view` and `close`.
center-morph-modal: The `trigger` slot defines the trigger text. The panel expands from the trigger's position, `v-model:open` controls it, and `label` provides the accessible name.
bouncy-accordion: `items` defines the item titles and content. `v-model` sets the expanded item. Arrow keys, Home and End move focus, and Enter or Space toggles the panel.
drawer: `v-model:open` controls the native modal drawer, and `side` picks left or right. The default slot receives a `close` function. Esc and clicking the backdrop close it.
smooth-scroll: Drives window scrolling by default. `:root="false"` creates a local region. `lerp`, `duration`, `orientation`, `wheelMultiplier` and `touch` are supported. Child ScrollTo, Parallax and ScrollProgress instances share the container.
cylinder-carousel: `items` and the scoped slot provide the slides. `variant` picks concave or convex, and `snap`, `arc`, `dragSpeed` and `autoRotate` adjust the rotation. `indexChange` reports the current index.
loader: `variant` picks one of 17 shape, character or number loading animations. `size`, `speed` and `paused` control the display, and `label` provides the screen-reader hint.
aspect-ratio: `ratio` is the width-to-height ratio (a positive number, 1 by default), `animated` controls the layout animation, and `contentClassName` styles the inner layer. `AspectRatioImage` takes `src`, `alt` and the image's original `width` and `height`, keeping the cover crop across different frames.
alert: `variant` supports default, info, success, warning and destructive. Control visibility with `v-model:open` or `defaultOpen`, and receive changes through `@open-change`. Combine AlertIcon, AlertContent, AlertTitle, AlertDescription, AlertAction and AlertClose. `returnFocusRef` points at the focus target after closing, and `labels.dismiss` customizes the button name. `useAlert()` provides reactive state and `dismiss()` to descendants.
card: `variant` supports outlined / muted, and `size` supports default / compact. `interactive` provides pointer feedback, and `selected` marks the selection. Use `CARD_TARGET_CLASS` on controls that own the click area. CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardAction, CardContent and CardFooter can be composed, and `CardTitle.as` selects the heading level.
collapsible: Manage the open state with `v-model:open`, `defaultOpen` or `@open-change`, and disable with `disabled`. CollapsibleTrigger (supports `render` to pass a custom button component), CollapsibleIndicator and CollapsibleContent combine the trigger and the content; the default slot and `useCollapsible()` expose `open`, `setOpen` and `toggle`.
switch: `v-model:checked` binds both ways, or use `:checked` with `@checked-change`. `disabled` disables interaction, `label` shows an associated label, and `ariaLabel` names a switch that has no external label.
table: Provide `data`, `columns` and a stable `getRowId`. `height`, `rowHeight` and `overscan` set up virtual scrolling. `v-model:sort` and `v-model:selected-row-ids` sync sorting and selection. `resizable` and `reorderable` support dragging and the arrow keys.
table-editable: Set `editable` on a column in `columns`. `@cell-edit` receives the row id, column key and new value. `@column-rename`, `@insert-row`, `@delete-row`, `@insert-column` and `@delete-column` enable the corresponding structural edits; the caller owns the data and column definitions.
table-async: `@end-reached` fires when the viewport nears the bottom. Set `loading` to pause repeated notifications and show the skeleton, then clear `loading` after updating `data`; `skeletonRows` controls the number of placeholder rows while appending. The example generates local data page by page.
button-stateful: `state` accepts idle, loading, success and error. `loadingText`, `successText` and `errorText` provide the state copy. Repeated submission is blocked while busy.
expanding-arrow-button: The default slot provides the action name; hovering or keyboard focus expands the dot-matrix arrow. Native button attributes are supported.
slide-action-button: Slide past `threshold` (0.82 by default) or press Enter / Space to emit `@complete`. `resetDelay` is in milliseconds; a negative value keeps the completed state.
theme-toggle: `v-model:theme` syncs light / dark. `variant` supports rectangle, circle, circle-blur and blinds, and `start` sets the reveal direction.
digit-swap: `value` accepts strings and numbers, `direction` controls the up or down roll, and `duration` and `stagger` are in seconds. `suffixLength` keeps the position of the trailing characters.
number-ticker: `value` is the target number, and `pad`, `decimals`, `locale`, `format` and the prefix and suffix determine the display format. `startOnView` starts the roll on first entering the viewport.
animated-number: `value` sets the target, `duration` is in seconds, `format` can format intermediate values, and `startOnView` controls the first playback.
animated-badge: `status` supports neutral, info, success, warning, danger and loading. `size`, `pulse`, `showIcon` and `#icon` control the appearance.
range-slider: `v-model`, `min`, `max` and `step` define the range. `showTicks` toggles the ticks. Pointer dragging, arrow keys, Home, End and PageUp / PageDown are supported.
range-slider-fluid: `variant="fluid"` inverts the filled region's text with a clipped layer. `v-model` syncs the value, and `label` and `format` customize the reading.
range-slider-inline: `variant="inline"` puts the label, reading and handle on one line; `v-model`, `step`, `min` and `max` control the value.
range-slider-wave: `variant="wave"` draws a wave crest that follows the pointer, and `bars` sets the number of amplitude bars. Sync the value with `v-model`.
range-slider-bubble: `variant="bubble"` shows the reading while dragging, `format` supports custom formatting, and `formatValueText` sets the assistive-technology reading.
range-slider-ruler: `variant="ruler"` can be dragged horizontally; `majorEvery`, `gap` and `unit` set the major tick frequency, spacing and unit respectively.
wheel-picker: `options` accepts strings or `{label,value}`, and `v-model` syncs the selected value. The wheel, touch and keyboard all work, and `itemHeight` and `visibleCount` control the size.
button-base: Set the content with the default slot; pass `href` to render a link, and other native attributes are forwarded to the interactive element.
tabs: `items` defines the tab items; `v-model` syncs the selected value, `defaultValue` sets the initial one, and `variant` controls the appearance. Customize content with the `#trigger`, `#icon` and `#panel` slots.
before-after-slider: `#before` and `#after` provide the comparison content. `v-model` syncs the divider position, `defaultValue` sets the initial position, `disabled` disables interaction, and `labels` customizes the text.
animated-toast-stack: `toasts` provides the notification list, and `@dismiss` handles closing. `position`, `placement`, `portal` and `maxVisible` can be set. `useAnimatedToastStack` manages the notification lifecycle.
line-chart: `series` defines the data series. `v-model:active-id` and `v-model:hidden-series` are supported, and the chart, legend and tooltip layers can be composed.
shader-background: `variant` picks the render preset, and `params` passes that preset's parameters. The background is a decorative layer; place the foreground content in a sibling element.
